Clear-signing v0 manifest — single source of truth for the on-device contract registry and FT selector table. The codegen (tools/clear-signing-codegen/) reads this file and emits C tables (ledger-app/src/clear_signing_v0/*.gen.{h,c}), the demo TS preflight registry (apps/demo-browser/src/clear-signing/{registry,selectors}.generated.ts), and the SDK TS deploy table (packages/aztec-ledger/src/clear_signing_v0/deploy_profiles.generated.ts). All must agree.

Security model (codex final-review BLOCKER #2): this manifest is the reviewed authority. The codegen script verifies that the pinned @defi-wonderland/aztec-standards artifact and @aztec/noir-contracts.js SponsoredFPC artifact produce the SAME (selector, arg_count, visibility) tuple for every verb. CI fails on shape mismatch.

_meta.deployments_source_METADATA_ONLY: ../../../nulo-2/packages/faucet/src/contracts/deployments.json (used at codegen-time for human cross-check ONLY; NOT a build dependency — values below are committed)

registry._note: Deterministic from SPONSORED_FPC_SALT=0; same address on mainnet/testnet/sandbox.

Nulo's existing Dripper (salt=1337, declared minter for nulo USDC at slot 0 and nulo ETH at slot 1). Source: nulo-2/packages/faucet/src/contracts/deployments.json. No redeploy — reuse only. Decimals=0 because amounts shown to the user are in the TOKEN-arg's decimals, looked up cross-slot at decode time (see DRIP_PUB verb below).

verbs._note: codex final-review BLOCKER #1: Aztec's SponsoredFeePaymentMethod builds this as a PRIVATE entrypoint (see aztec-packages/yarn-project/aztec.js/src/fee/sponsored_fee_payment.ts:29 sets type to FunctionType.PRIVATE). Empty-args private → args_hash = Fr.ZERO per computeVarArgsHash.

M6.0: Dripper.drip_to_public(token: AztecAddress, amount: u64). args[0] MUST be a TOKEN-kind slot in registry (AHW-041: enforced by the HOST preflight ONLY — append_call.c does NOT validate args[0]'s kind; the device renders a 'token'/decimals=0 fallback for a non-registered arg rather than rejecting). The amount is u64 (1 Fr slot, high 24 bytes zero per encoder.ts:24). Decimals for display come from the TOKEN-arg's registry entry (cross-slot lookup); Dripper's own slot has decimals=0. Selector computed via FunctionSelector.fromNameAndParameters from Dripper artifact at codegen-pinned aztec-standards version.

deploy_profiles._note: M7 P2: clear-signed deploy profile. ctor_arg_schema=ecdsa_k_pubkey_xy means the constructor takes [u8;32] x, [u8;32] y of the secp256k1 signing pubkey — flattens elementwise to 64 Frs in the Noir ABI encoder (encoder.ts:24-33). ctor_selector_u32 computed at codegen from FunctionSelector.fromNameAndParameters('constructor', getAllFunctionAbis(EcdsaKAccountContractArtifact).find(f=>f.name==='constructor').parameters). account_class_id cross-checked via computeContractClassId at codegen time, fail-closed on drift. sponsor_fpc_address + sponsor_selector_u32 pin the M5/M6 SponsoredFPC + sponsor_unconditionally selectors so the synthesized canonical-call list is deterministic. fee_mode=EXTERNAL matches the EXTERNAL u8 the account_entrypoint expects for FPC-sponsored deploys.

M10: clear-signed deploy profile for the canonical SchnorrAccount (Schnorr-over-Grumpkin). ctor_arg_schema=schnorr_pubkey_xy: the constructor takes (signing_pub_key_x: Field, signing_pub_key_y: Field) → 2 Frs (NOT the 64 byte-frs of ecdsa_k_pubkey_xy), so the device's args_hash = computeVarArgsHash([P.x, P.y]) (az_schnorr_compute_partial_address). class_id + ctor_selector cross-checked at codegen against SchnorrAccountContractArtifact (fail-closed on drift). sponsor_*/deployer/fee_mode identical to profile 0 — the signed deploy outer_hash is the entrypoint app_payload (sponsor_unconditionally + padding) which is scheme-independent; only the consumer (= device-derived account address from the Schnorr partial) differs. ctor_arg_byte_len=64 (2 Frs) is review metadata; it does NOT enter the signed outer_hash.
